arcanist_elf.notes: Extra slots must be filled from the kit's listed proficiencies

giant_killer.notes: Must be chosen from a restricted list

gladiator_fugitive_hillsfar.notes: Starts with only two slots regardless of Intelligence and can gain no more at 1st level

justifier.notes: In addition to the bonus Survival proficiency; later slots at the normal rate

medician.notes: Only one slot at 1st level, another at 3rd and a final one at 6th; may acquire no more than three proficiencies beyond her bonuses

natural_philosopher.notes: Weapon proficiency slots may be traded for nonweapon proficiencies

pacifist_druid.notes: Weapon proficiency slots may be traded for nonweapon proficiencies

savage_hunter.notes: Extra slots must be filled from the recommended proficiencies

scholar_monk.notes: Weapon proficiency slots may be traded for nonweapon proficiencies

scholar_priest.notes: Weapon proficiency slots may be traded for nonweapon proficiencies

sheenchaser.notes: If a Wizard takes the kit mid-career he forgoes the next nonweapon proficiency from level progression

stridesman.notes: The extra proficiency must be spent on local history or an additional language

totemic_druid.notes: Starts with three slots rather than four

wizards_of_waterdeep.notes: Six slots at creation (two extra) plus Intelligence bonus; one slot every two levels instead of three

clansdwarf.notes: Two craft proficiency slots, both on the same craft
